clocks: Demonstration time only; no random events. Shared uint32 seed stored for API compatibility. Classic phase starts at 0 and persists between loads; candidate starts open at -pi/2.
limitations: Classic whole-chain global fit versus candidate CORE display fit can change interpolated paths. Endpoint relative-domain agreement is not an experimental transition trajectory.
No ATP/AMP pool, ADP production, reaction rate or catalytic stoichiometric playback.
Coarse surfaces and residue displacement fields, not atomic molecular dynamics.
